title: Claude Code Concepts - Context Window and Models
content: The context window in Claude code allows for a customizable size depending on the model used. Models are the brains behind Claude code, differing in size and capability. Larger models think better but cost more per token. Smaller models are cheaper but less capable. To switch between models, use the /model command. The /effort command controls how hard the model thinks, with low effort for simple tasks and high effort for complex ones.
